classification_evidence.entrypoint_callability_signature_failure: real EvalPlus task entry point missing/non-callable/signature mismatch before tests
classification_evidence.pass: actual EvalPlus base and plus PASS
classification_evidence.runtime_exception: sandbox worker or EvalPlus structured exception class during actual test execution
classification_evidence.test_assertion_wrong_answer: actual EvalPlus base/plus test completed with explicit assertion/fail outcome after a callable invocation
classification_evidence.timeout: per-cell parent timeout or EvalPlus timeout status

execution_contract.per_cell: raw and final are separate OS-sandboxed invocations
execution_contract.tests: actual EvalPlus 0.3.1 HumanEval+/MBPP+ base and plus tests via public check_correctness

limitations: This runner intentionally refuses execution when these Linux primitives are unavailable; Windows alone is not an equivalent security boundary.
The host must permit unprivileged bubblewrap user namespaces and systemd transient cgroups; preflight checks presence, execution validates command success.
Kernel vulnerabilities and a malicious host administrator are outside this sandbox threat model.

policy.cpu_memory_pids: systemd-run transient cgroup: CPUQuota, MemoryMax, TasksMax
policy.privileges: bubblewrap user namespace, --cap-drop ALL, --new-session, then setpriv --no-new-privs
policy.timeout: parent subprocess timeout per raw/final cell
policy.writable_storage: only sandbox /tmp tmpfs and per-cell /work tmpfs
